measured_on: branch feature/kb-8c, main 4a5d3460d3; before = ve/units.py of main (458bc5a8c0's Lean, same ve_service binary), after = 30965b84aa; 2026-11-14
method: a throwaway sitecustomize on PYTHONPATH (not committed) wraps LeanService.run_bound and LeanServicePool.run_bound (every relayed chunk goes through one of them; the forkserver workers load it too) and counts the cases of modes check and quantity by kind; 'with a quantity member' are cases with a `quantity` member and no `kind`. With KB8C_SHADOW=1 (the before run) it also asks, beside every ve.units._checked_quantity call, the quantity mode's admission kind for the same environment and payload (not counted) and compares environment_id, Q, core and meaning_id. Each harness ran once per side, in parallel, under manage-agents/iso.sh (16G).
notes: before: 'check, with a quantity member' is the number of _checked_quantity calls the shadow saw (each sends exactly one check case); the before run's recorder did not yet tag such cases, so 'check, other' is the check total (eligibility 62,633; RSP 20,400; Preparedness 86,320; FSF 10,377; agent policy 17,715) minus that number. The after run tagged them directly (recorder.py.txt is the after version).

eligibility's typing check cases are 9,804 before and 9,803 after: one case, in the path this item does not change (ve/ast.py typing). That path asks through relay.decide_once, whose per-pool memo is shared by the harness's threads; a race there would explain one case. This was not proved.

after: 'admission (no kind)' counts every quantity case with a quantity member and no kind: eligibility's own admission cases (6,781, which also carry a model) plus the 52,829 _checked_quantity cases moved from check.
